args.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT a.artregistry, a.artname, a.conservestatus::text AS cs,
         s.insvalueusd, r.histsignrating, r.cultscore,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.histsignrating) AS pr_hist,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.cultscore) AS pr_cult
  FROM artifactscore a
  JOIN artifactsecurityaccess s ON s.artref = a.artregistry
  JOIN artifactratings r ON r.artref = a.artregistry
),
cat AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE WHEN insvalueusd > 1000000 THEN 'Monetary High-Value'
         WHEN pr_hist >= 0.9 AND pr_cult >= 0.9 THEN 'Cultural/Historical High-Value'
         ELSE 'Other' END AS valuecat
  FROM base
)
SELECT c.artregistry, c.artname, c.insvalueusd, c.cs, c.valuecat
FROM cat c
JOIN conservationandmaintenance m ON m.artrefmaintained = c.artregistry
WHERE c.valuecat <> 'Other'
  AND c.cs = 'Critical'
  AND m.treatpriority = 'Urgent'
ORDER BY c.artregistry;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT a.artregistry, a.artname, a.conservestatus::text AS cs,
         s.insvalueusd, r.histsignrating, r.cultscore,
         NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY r.histsignrating) AS nt_hist,
         NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY r.cultscore) AS nt_cult
  FROM artifactscore a
  JOIN artifactsecurityaccess s ON s.artref = a.artregistry
  JOIN artifactratings r ON r.artref = a.artregistry
),
cat AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE WHEN insvalueusd > 1000000 THEN 'Monetary High-Value'
         WHEN nt_hist=10 AND nt_cult=10 THEN 'Cultural/Historical High-Value'

JOIN conservationandmaintenance m ON m.artrefmaintained = c.artregistry
WHERE c.valuecat <> 'Other'

ORDER BY c.artregistry;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT a.artregistry, a.artname, a.conservestatus::text AS cs,
         s.insvalueusd, r.histsignrating, r.cultscore,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.histsignrating) AS pr_hist,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.cultscore) AS pr_cult
  FROM artifactscore a
  JOIN artifactsecurityaccess s ON s.artref = a.artregistry
  JOIN artifactratings r ON r.artref = a.artregistry
),
cat AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE WHEN insvalueusd > 1000000 THEN 'Monetary High-Value'
         WHEN pr_hist >= 0.9 AND pr_cult >= 0.9 THEN 'Cultural/Historical High-Value'
         ELSE 'Other' END AS valuecat
  FROM base
)
SELECT c.artregistry, c.artname, c.insvalueusd, c.cs, c.valuecat
FROM cat c
JOIN conservationandmaintenance m ON m.artrefmaintained = c.artregistry
WHERE c.valuecat <> 'Other'
  AND c.cs = 'Critical'
  AND m.treatpriority = 'Urgent'
ORDER BY c.artregistry;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT a.artregistry, a.artname, a.conservestatus::text AS cs,
         s.insvalueusd, r.histsignrating, r.cultscore,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.histsignrating) AS pr_hist,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.cultscore) AS pr_cult
  FROM artifactscore a
  JOIN artifactsecurityaccess s ON s.artref = a.artregistry
  JOIN artifactratings r ON r.artref = a.artregistry
),
cat AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE WHEN insvalueusd > 1000000 THEN 'Monetary High-Value'
         WHEN pr_hist >= 0.9 AND pr_cult >= 0.9 THEN 'Cultural/Historical High-Value'
         ELSE 'Other' END AS valuecat
  FROM base
)
SELECT c.artregistry, c.artname, c.insvalueusd, c.cs, c.valuecat
FROM cat c
JOIN conservationandmaintenance m ON m.artrefmaintained = c.artregistry
WHERE c.valuecat <> 'Other'
  AND c.cs = 'Critical'
  AND m.treatpriority = 'Urgent'
ORDER BY c.artregistry;

args.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT a.artregistry, a.artname, a.conservestatus::text AS cs,
         s.insvalueusd, r.histsignrating, r.cultscore,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.histsignrating) AS pr_hist,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.cultscore) AS pr_cult
  FROM artifactscore a
  JOIN artifactsecurityaccess s ON s.artref = a.artregistry
  JOIN artifactratings r ON r.artref = a.artregistry
),
cat AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE WHEN insvalueusd > 1000000 THEN 'Monetary High-Value'
         WHEN pr_hist >= 0.9 AND pr_cult >= 0.9 THEN 'Cultural/Historical High-Value'
         ELSE 'Other' END AS valuecat
  FROM base
)
SELECT c.artregistry, c.artname, c.insvalueusd, c.cs, c.valuecat
FROM cat c
JOIN conservationandmaintenance m ON m.artrefmaintained = c.artregistry
WHERE c.valuecat <> 'Other'
  AND c.cs = 'Critical'
  AND m.treatpriority = 'Urgent'
ORDER BY c.artregistry;
